description.p: Sheet is the spreadsheet of grind, an office suite whose native format is OpenDocument.

It reads and writes OpenDocument Spreadsheet (.ods, .fods) files directly, against the OASIS ODF specification rather than through a translation layer. It is not a port of LibreOffice and shares no code with it.

It also opens Excel workbooks (.xlsx, .xlsm) by importing them: a workbook comes up as a new, unsaved ODF spreadsheet, with a sentence saying what — if anything — had nowhere to go. It never writes an Excel file, and it never makes itself the default for one.
A CSV or TSV file opens the same way: a new ODF spreadsheet named after it, the delimiter read from the file itself.

ul.li: Formulas with OpenFormula's own semantics, not Excel's, and an assistant while typing them
Cell styles, number formats, merged cells, charts and conditional formatting
Saves by changing as little of a file as it can, so a flat .fods diffs line by line
A command palette (Ctrl+K) that finds every command the window has
